caption: We're honoring the fictional pups that earned our tears for National Dog Day. The Art of Racing in the Rain sees life through Enzo the dog's eyes. Marley & Me follows the "world's worst dog" teaching unconditional love. Lassie ran for 20 years as the symbol of loyalty.
